overview: Explain the dominant biological program behind a gene set, connect it to pathway evidence, and make uncertainty explicit.
grounding_requirements: Every substantive report section after Question and Context must include a visible `Sources:` line immediately after the supported content.
Mechanistic claims must be tied to named evidence streams such as investigation bundles, pathway context, interaction networks, or retrieved literature.

When a section contains synthesis, alternative explanations, hypothesis ranking, or next-step recommendations beyond direct retrieval, label it explicitly as interpretation, alternative explanation, or critical next check.
Prefer human-readable provider names, paper titles, figure links, and artifact links in `Sources:` lines. Keep raw ids and tool names secondary.
Include the major mechanistic evidence artifacts in `linked_artifact_ids` when saving the report.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Question and Context
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Frame the panel and question from the task context; retrieval is optional if this section only establishes scope.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: Keep this section descriptive rather than argumentative.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Mechanistic Hypotheses
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: State the leading mechanism using the strongest retrieved pathway, network, and literature evidence from the current session.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line naming the main evidence streams that support the leading hypothesis.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: If the mechanism statement integrates multiple evidence streams into a higher-level biological synthesis, keep that explicit as interpretation rather than direct fact.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Supporting Evidence
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: This section should be the most directly grounded part of the report, tying hypotheses to retrieved pathway, interaction, enrichment, or literature evidence.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line with human-readable providers, paper links, figure links, and artifact links when available.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Alternative Explanations
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Use retrieved evidence to justify why competing explanations remain plausible or weaker.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line when alternatives are grounded in specific evidence streams.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: Label this section clearly as alternative explanations or interpretation when it goes beyond direct retrieval.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Hypothesis Tiers
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Rank the mechanism ideas according to the evidence already gathered rather than unsupported confidence.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: Add a visible `Sources:` line pointing to the evidence streams used for the ranking.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: Make clear that the tiering is a synthesis judgment over the retrieved evidence.

section_grounding_expectations.heading: Critical Next Checks
section_grounding_expectations.evidence_expectation: Keep next checks aligned with evidence gaps or ambiguities uncovered in-session.
section_grounding_expectations.provenance_expectation: If specific next checks are motivated by retrieved evidence, add a `Sources:` line; otherwise keep the section clearly framed as next-step guidance.
section_grounding_expectations.interpretation_expectation: Label this section as critical next checks rather than as retrieved findings.

workflow_steps.instructions: Load the report templates and the mechanism template before evidence gathering.
workflow_steps.title: Load Template

workflow_steps.instructions: Start with a set-level investigation. Then run at least one grouped literature search anchored to the panel and dominant biological themes. Use pathway or interaction follow-up to strengthen the mechanistic explanation, distinguish alternatives, and carry named, section-local `Sources:` lines into the final report rather than relying on the tool trace alone.
workflow_steps.title: Gather Mechanism Evidence

workflow_steps.instructions: Draft the report using the mechanism template, save it, and revise only if needed for clarity or grounding. Every substantive section should expose visible provenance and major evidence artifacts should be linked in the saved report metadata.
workflow_steps.title: Save Report
